The client reported that the system was showing ice buildup on the furnace pipes and that the second floor of the house was not being adequately cooled.

Service fee for contracted client
Diagnostic Fee

Performed procedures:
• A full system measurement was carried out using a Fieldpiece digital manifold.
• The refrigerant charge was checked and found to be slightly below the ideal level, causing high superheat and low subcooling.
• A controlled addition of refrigerant was performed, with continuous monitoring until system parameters stabilized.
• The condenser was washed, as it showed moderate dirt buildup, which may have contributed to loss of efficiency and freezing.
• The air filters were inspected and found to be clean and in good condition.
• At the client's request, the operation of the second-floor zone was checked, and no mechanical or functional issues were found. It was explained to the client that, as it is the highest part of the house, it naturally takes longer to reach the desired temperature.

Routing and connection of refrigerant line sets, low-voltage control wiring, and condensate drainage

Coordination with Airzone zoning system components (as applicable)
